QA Objective / Scenario: Verify that products can be filtered by searching keyword in search bar
Preconditions: Valid user is signed in to ShopSphere E-commerce and the relevant module is available.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to ShopSphere homepage.
2. Type "Wireless" in the search input box.
3. Press Enter or click the Search icon.
Expected Result: Only products matching "Wireless" (e.g. Wireless Headphones, Wireless Mouse) are listed in the grid.
